revision_history.summary: Initial audit: obtainability, licences, content hashes, contamination exposure.

CORRECTION. Revision 1 reported the unpublished deepxiv paper-search backend as the hard blocker for AutoResearchBench official evaluation, and described MetaSyn retrieval/screening as only 'in principle' credential-free. Both conflated a benchmark's reference agent with its scorer, sourced from example.env and README rather than from the code. Verified at the pinned revisions: AutoResearchBench Wide scores with no credentials (400/400 wide records carry usable gold arXiv ids), Deep needs only a judge endpoint (deterministic id-match deviation available for 540/600), and MetaSyn's retrieval/screening scoring path imports no LLM client. Added official_evaluation_runnable_by_family so the distinction is machine-readable. The SAGE verdict is unchanged. No content hash, licence or state value changed.

revision_history.correction_of_a_correction: An orchestrator note claimed this audit had mis-enumerated the SAGE repository as "777 KB, 11 entries". That claim was wrong: 777 KB is GitHub"'s repository size field and the 11 tree entries are README plus eight query files plus two directories, which this audit had already enumerated correctly. The substantive gap was the missing usability verdict, not a bad inventory.
revision_history.summary: Added usable_task_family_under_declared_deviation. The official-scorer verdicts are unchanged and were correct: SAGE"'s corpus and evaluator are genuinely unpublished. What was missing is the separate fact that SAGE"'s 1200 queries and their gold ARE obtainable and give the largest external N available to this paper, so the family belongs in the study under declared scoring rather than being struck from it.

Official Deep LLM title judge executed for the declared keyless public-arXiv probe via local OpenAI-compatible protocol adapter (judge model glm-5.3, temperature 0.5, pinned judge prompt): 600/600 Deep tasks scored, hit rate 0.000. Nine-case judge control CONTROL_PASSED. Archive: evidence/external_results/DEEP_OFFICIAL_ARCHIVE_V1.json; control: evidence/external_results/DEEP_JUDGE_CONTROL_2026-08-17.json. Bounded probe only (external_probe_not_full_multi_provider_orion); matched multi-provider Deep comparison remains unexecuted.

run_requirements.layer_separation_note: CORRECTED 2026-08-16 (supersedes the v1 record). The first pass reported the unpublished deepxiv paper-search backend as the hard blocker for official evaluation. That conflated two independent layers. Verified at the pinned revision: PAPER_SEARCH_API_URL, deepxiv and SERPER appear only in run_inference.sh, inference.py, tool_deepxivsearch.py and tool_websearch.py, and in no file under evaluate/. They are inputs to the repository's own reference agent, not to the scorer. They block reproducing the authors' baseline agent; they do not block running our system on their tasks and scoring it officially.

wide.detail: evaluate/evaluate_wide_search.py scores with compute_iou_recall(gt_ids, pred_ids), pure set arithmetic over normalize_arxiv_id strings. get_gt_arxiv_ids returns input_data['arxiv_id'] directly whenever it normalises to a non-empty set, and reaches the Jina title lookup only 'if use_jina and JINA_API_KEY' -- with no key set it returns an empty set rather than erroring. A --no-jina flag disables the fallback explicitly. get_predicted_arxiv_ids reads candidate['arxiv_id'] locally with no lookup. main() raises SystemExit only for a missing --input or --gt file, never for a missing credential.
wide.gold_coverage_verified: 400 of 400 wide records in the decrypted bundle carry an arxiv_id list that normalises to a non-empty set, so the Jina path is never reached for any wide task.
wide.candidate_output_contract: get_predicted_arxiv_ids reads candidate.get('arxiv_id') from each entry of final_candidates. A candidate system that emits titles only, without an arxiv_id per final candidate, scores IoU 0.0 against every task. Any adapter must attach a resolved arXiv id to each returned candidate.
wide.determinism_caveat: avg_iou, avg_recall and avg_precision are exact and were bit-identical across five identical runs. The avg_max_iou_at_k family is unseeded Monte-Carlo -- see cross_cutting_findings.

executed.command: env -u JINA_API_KEY -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u SERPER_API_KEY -u EVAL_OPENAI_API_KEY -u PAPER_SEARCH_API_URL -u OPENAI_API_BASE python3 evaluate_wide_search.py --input <synthetic>.jsonl --output <out>.json
executed.input: Synthetic inference file built from three real wide records (gold sizes 20, 21, 6) with one perfect, one partial-plus-false-positive and one empty prediction.
executed.hand_check: Metrics reproduce by hand from the set arithmetic, so the scorer is behaving as read.
executed.outcome_blind_note: This is a self-test of the scorer on synthetic input. No ORION or baseline output was scored and these are not results for any system.

deep.credentials: an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint for the LLM judge
deep.detail: evaluate/evaluate_deep_search.py compares gold titles (input_data['answer']) to candidate titles via LLMJudge.are_titles_matching. It calls parser.error and refuses to run when --model/EVAL_MODEL or --api-base/EVAL_OPENAI_API_BASE is unset. One judge call per (gold title x candidate title) pair; max_candidates_per_pass defaults to 1, so about one judge call per deep task per pass, times K_PASSES times stochastic_repeats.
deep.declared_deviation_available: A deterministic id-match variant is possible because deep records also carry arxiv_id, scoring gold ids against candidate ids exactly as Wide does. Coverage is partial and must be declared: 540 of 600 deep records normalise to a usable id set; the remaining 60 carry arxiv_id [''] and would need the LLM judge or a predeclared symmetric exclusion. A deviation run must report the 540/600 denominator explicitly and must not silently drop the 60.

reference_agent_requirements.blocks: Reproducing the authors' own baseline agent only.
reference_agent_requirements.detail: example.env leaves PAPER_SEARCH_API_URL blank and defaults SEARCH_TOOL=deepxiv, which resolves to tool_deepxivsearch.py against a service the repository does not publish. MAX_TURNS defaults to 10 agent turns per task, each turn issuing an agent LLM call plus tool calls whose summarisers are themselves LLM calls, so one full pass over 1000 tasks is order 1e4 agent calls plus a comparable number of summariser calls.
reference_agent_requirements.consequence: The AutoResearchBench-native agent cannot serve as one of our matched baselines. Our own baselines (BM25, dense, hybrid, one-pass RAG, agentic single-route) are unaffected and are scored by the same official scorer.

run_requirements.hard_blocker: None for official Wide scoring, which needs no credentials at all. Deep as-shipped needs a judge endpoint, with a partial deterministic deviation available for 540 of 600 records. The unpublished deepxiv backend blocks only the authors' reference agent, not the evaluator.

artifacts.contamination_note: Wide gold is a set of real arXiv ids and our discovery routes are the arXiv and OpenAlex APIs, so the specific exposure is that a route can return the benchmark's own artifacts as ordinary search results: the AutoResearchBench paper (arXiv:2604.25256), its GitHub repository or its HuggingFace dataset page can surface for a topical query and hand a candidate the answer key rather than the paper the task is about. Route logs must therefore be scanned for these three identifiers per query and any hit reported, not merely for generic 'answer leakage'. Separately, the bundle's obfuscation is key-less and locally reversible, and gold labels ship inside the question records, so access_policy.hidden_labels must be enforced by the ORION harness. Deep additionally depends on an LLM judge whose model identity must be frozen in the run manifest.

official_evaluation_runnable_by_family.note: Keys are the task_families of PROTOCOL_V1.json. This field exists because the v1 audit buried the evaluator-versus-reference-agent distinction in prose and a downstream reader took a blanket blocker from it. offline_complete_gold is host-owned and out of this lane's scope.

cross_cutting_findings: The official scorers are separable from the reference agents that ship beside them, and conflating the two understates what is runnable. AutoResearchBench Wide scores with no credentials at all (pure set IoU over gold arXiv ids that are present for 400 of 400 wide records); MetaSyn's retrieval and screening scoring path imports no LLM client. The unpublished deepxiv backend and the Serper/Jina keys block only reproducing the benchmark authors' own baseline agent. The correct unit of analysis is which module reads which variable, not which variables a project's example.env declares.

Running our system against the official AutoResearchBench Wide scorer imposes an output contract, not just a credential: get_predicted_arxiv_ids reads candidate['arxiv_id'] from each final candidate, so any adapter must attach a resolved arXiv id to every returned candidate or score 0.0 on every task.

Part of the official AutoResearchBench Wide metric is not deterministic across runs, and the noise is large relative to the protocol's own effect size. evaluate/evaluate_wide_search.py defines max_iou_at_k_sampling(iou_list, k, sample_times=1000), which loops random.sample(list(iou_list), k) 1000 times; neither that file, evaluate_deep_search.py nor utils.py calls random.seed or constructs a seeded Random. Measured, not inferred: five identical invocations at three passes per record (matching statistics.stochastic_repeats=3) returned avg_iou 0.52672 every time, while avg_max_iou_at_1 ranged 0.512767-0.521167 and avg_max_iou_at_2 ranged 0.822500-0.835167 -- run-to-run spreads of about 0.008 and 0.013 on a [0,1] scale, from re-running the scorer alone with no change to any system. statistics.practical_margin targets +0.03 absolute, so this noise is roughly a third of the effect the study intends to detect. Three consequences: (a) an execution_bindings.evaluator_hash pins the evaluator code but not the metric value, so a Wide freeze must pin a seed or declare avg_max_iou_at_k as sampling-noisy; (b) the guard 'if len(record_ious) >= k' means avg_max_iou_at_4, _at_8 and _at_16 receive no samples at 3 repeats and report 0.0 -- these are absent measurements, not scores, and must not be tabulated; (c) avg_iou and avg_recall are exact and are the safe primary Wide metrics.

Two of the four pinned code repositories (HughieHu/Sage, OxRML/AgentSLR) carry no licence at any depth of their pinned trees, so JOURNAL_READINESS section 8 'frozen corpora/index snapshots where redistribution permits' cannot be satisfied for them.
The SAGE task family (sage_scientific_retrieval) has neither a published retrieval corpus nor an official evaluator, so it cannot be executed as specified regardless of licensing or budget.

Of the four external families, two score without credentials (autoresearchbench_wide, metasyn_retrieval_screening), one needs only a judge endpoint (autoresearchbench_deep, with a deterministic id-match deviation available for 540 of 600 records), and one cannot be run at all (sage_scientific_retrieval). The AgentSLR pipeline remains credential- and PDF-bound, but it is a baseline rather than a protocol task family.

AutoResearchBench's obfuscation is key-less and locally reversible, and its gold labels ship inside the same records as the questions, so PROTOCOL_V1.json access_policy.hidden_labels must be enforced by the ORION harness rather than assumed from the benchmark.
SAGE's gold set is public plaintext and web-indexed, making any live-provider SAGE result contaminated by construction.
explicitly_not_established: Contamination rates for any benchmark. Only structural exposure plus two spot-check queries were performed.
Whether a private or unlisted SAGE corpus exists. HuggingFace returns 401 for both absent and private repositories to unauthenticated callers and no credentials were supplied.

Whether the MetaSyn retrieval/screening scorer executes end to end. Its credential-independence was established by reading the import graph, not by running it; the corpus encode was out of scope for this session. The AutoResearchBench Wide scorer WAS executed and is not subject to this caveat.
Whether the Deep LLM judge behaves as documented, since no judge endpoint was exercised.
Total monetary cost of a full evaluation. Call-count scale is estimated from configuration defaults; no provider pricing was applied.

enum.NOT_USABLE: Neither an official nor a declared-scoring run is possible.
enum.USABLE_OFFICIAL: Runnable and scored by the benchmark's own evaluator.
enum.USABLE_WITH_DECLARED_SCORING: Queries and gold are obtainable and the task can be run, but at least one scoring element is host-defined and must be labelled a declared deviation.

usable_task_family_under_declared_deviat.note: Separate question from official-scorer runnability. A family can be unusable for an OFFICIAL number while still being a legitimate external task set under scoring we declare as a deviation. Collapsing the two is what made an earlier reading of this audit treat SAGE as removed from the paper entirely.

sage_scientific_retrieval_detail.consequence_for_contamination: Search-time contamination stays the binding risk: gold sits in the same public plaintext GitHub record as the query, so a live run must measure exposure to the benchmark's own artifacts rather than assume it away. Unchanged from revision 1.
sage_scientific_retrieval_detail.consequence_for_statistics: Short-form alone is N=600, which clears the frozen statistical plan's TIER_B (N >= 385, half-width 0.05 at assumed_p 0.5). It is therefore the largest external task set available to this paper, and larger than the 400 released AutoResearchBench Wide tasks.

missing.official_evaluator: No evaluator ships at the pinned revision.
missing.open_ended_tier_weights: README states weighted recall over tiers with decreasing weights but never states the weights, so any weighted-recall number is host-defined.
missing.retrieval_corpus: Unpublished, so the authors' closed-index setting cannot be reproduced. The queries can still be run open-world, which is this paper's setting.

obtainable.verified_by: Two of the eight files downloaded from the pinned commit and parsed; counts and field names read off the parsed objects, not the README.

sage_scientific_retrieval_detail.redistribution: Still blocked: no licence at the pinned revision, so hashes and counts may be recorded but the data may not be vendored.
